title: Single CTV preroll slot with structured user agent and a GPP consent string

source.name: IAB OpenRTB 2.6 Object: Device (sua) and Object: Regs (gpp, gpp_sid)
source.license: CC BY 3.0 (OpenRTB 2.6 field semantics); MIT (original fixture)
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All auction, bid, creative, app and publisher identifiers are synthetic.
device.ua is a synthetic Smart-TV-labelled string kept alongside device.sua, matching the 2.6 §3.2.18 recommendation to keep sending ua for backwards compatibility even when sua is present.

regs.gpp uses the corpus-wide non-decodable placeholder string (matching banner-x-gpid-tid-gpp-26's convention), not a real or realistic-looking consent string. regs.gpp_sid=[7] (US National) is supplied alongside it so neither gpp_sid_without_string nor gpp_string_without_sid fires.

Coverage closure: VAST4.0 XSD: move AdTitle after Impression and supply the required UniversalAdId.idValue attribute. Corrected body independently validates with xmllint against pinned IAB VAST revision e0858cd714474bf17ef61065097456d7643ff838.
provenance.sanitized: No production payload or PII used. Placeholder GPP string only, not a real consent record. All resource and tracking hosts end in .test; external network must remain blocked.

pairApplicability.note: Use x-openrtb-version: 2.6 when replaying HTTP; envelope itself has no version field.

specNotes: Single (non-pod) CTV preroll slot, distinct from the existing dynamic-pod CTV case; protocols [7,8] (VAST 4.0 Inline/Wrapper) are declared, the bid answers with Inline VAST 4.0 (protocol 7).
device.sua/regs.gpp are not read by packages/core/format-detect.js beyond 2.6-version detection; they carry no dedicated validation rule, so this pair asserts no false errors from their presence.
Validity describes protocol structure and declared constraints; generated media bytes must be checked against declared MIME/duration before playback tests.
Current Inspector contract displays VAST as inert XML; text visibility must not be counted as creative rendering or media playback.
fixtureAssets lists controlled resources; intercept .test URLs locally. Never fetch public advertising/tracking hosts.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.

preview.capabilityGap: The current VAST preview is inert XML; video/audio playback and Wrapper resolution are not implemented.
